text: 创业板指跌超1%，沪指涨0.3%，深成指跌0.48%，6G、玻璃基板、CPO、卫星导航等方向跌幅居前，沪深京三市下跌个股超2600只。
text_en: ChiNext fell over 1%, Shanghai Composite rose 0.3%, Shenzhen Component fell 0.48%, with 6G, glass substrate, CPO, satellite navigation leading declines; over 2,600 stocks fell across Shanghai, Shenzhen, and Beijing markets.
